g.text: ADVANCED OFFENSIVE CYBERSECURITY & RED TEAM ROADMAP
-A: Enable OS detection, version detection, script scanning,
--datadir <dirname>: Specify custom Nmap data file location
--send-eth/--send-ip: Send using raw ethernet frames or IP
--privileged: Assume that the user is fully privileged
--unprivileged: Assume the user lacks raw socket privileges
-sL: List Scan - simply list targets to scan
-Pn: Treat all hosts as online -- skip host discovery
-PS/PA/PU/PY: TCP SYN/ACK, UDP or SCTP discovery to given
-oN/-oX/-oS/-oG <file>: Output scan in normal, XML, s|<rIpt
-PE/PP/PM: ICMP echo, timestamp, and netmask request
format, respectively, to the given filename.
-oA <basename>: Output in the three major formats at once
-v: Increase verbosity level (use -vv or more for greater
-d: Increase debugging level (use -dd or more for greater
--reason: Display the reason a port is in a particular state
--traceroute: Trace hop path to each host
--open: Only show open (or possibly open) ports
--packet-trace: Show all packets sent and received
--iflist: Print host interfaces and routes (for debugging)
--append-output: Append to rather than clobber specified
-sN/sF/sX: TCP Null, FIN, and Xmas scans
--webxml: Reference stylesheet from Nmap.Org for more
--no-stylesheet: Prevent associating of XSL stylesheet w/XML
-F: Fast mode - Scan fewer ports than the default scan
--data <hex string>: Append a custom payload to sent packets
--data-string <string>: Append a custom ASCII string to sent
--data-length <num>: Append random data to sent packets
-sV: Probe open ports to determine service/version info
--badsum: Send packets with a bogus TCP/UDP/SCTP checksum
--script=<Lua scripts>: <Lua scripts> is a comma separated
--max-retries <tries>: Caps number of port scan probe
--host-timeout <time>: Give up on target after this long
--script-args-file=filename: provide NSE script args in a
--script-trace: Show all data sent and received
--min-rate <number>: Send packets no slower than <number> per
--max-rate <number>: Send packets no faster than <number> per
separated list of script-files or script-categories.
--osscan-limit: Limit OS detection to promising targets

text.tspan: OFFICIAL OFFENSIVE SECURITY & ADVERSARY SIMULATION ROADMAP
